#### Load data
```{r load data}

# Organoid from coculture
seurat <- readRDS("/home/marinani/PhD_Projects/Microglia/Microglia_article/Objects/Co-culture_timecourse/organoid_d3_d15_d30_d58_integrated.rds")

# Subset only day 30 organoid cells
seurat_org_d30 <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("ORG-d30-cocul", "ORG-d30-ctrl")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)

# Subset only day 58 organoid cells
seurat_org_d58 <- subset(seurat, subset = sample %in% c("ORG-d58-cocul", "ORG-d58-ctrl")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)

```

# Differential expression analysis between conditions

#### Basic DE analysis
```{r general similarity}

# General transcriptomic similarity between co-cultured vs 2D stem cell-derived microglia
Idents(seurat) <- "sample"

avg_expr_sample <- sapply(sort(unique(seurat$sample)), function(sample)
rowMeans(seurat@assays$RNA@data[,which(seurat$sample == sample)]))
colnames(avg_expr_sample) <- c("ORG-d3-ctrl","ORG-d15-ctrl","ORG-d30-ctrl","ORG-d58-ctrl", "ORG-d3-cocul","ORG-d15-cocul", "ORG-d30-cocul","ORG-d58-cocul")
corr_sample <- cor(avg_expr_sample[VariableFeatures(seurat),])
corr_sample
plot(hclust(as.dist(1-corr_sample)))
table(seurat$sample)

```
#### Perform wilcoxon test on organoid all time points
```{r perform wilcoxon test on organoid all time points}

# Run wilcoxon test
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org <- wilcoxauc(seurat, group_by = "condition") %>%
  filter(group == "COCUL") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA))

# Many padj values equal 0, meaning that they go to infinity as -lo10(padj) and cannot be plotted.
# The reason is that wilcoaux function rounds extremely small values to 0.
# To circumvent this is issue, we can change the 0 p-values (or p-adjusted values) to take the minimum value detected.
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org$padj[DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org$padj[which(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org$padj != 0)])

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           logFC < -log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org) 

# Remove genes coding for mitochondria and ribosome proteins
blacklist <- c(grep("^MT-", DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org$feature, value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
diff_genes <- setdiff(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org$feature,blacklist)
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org %>% filter(feature %in% diff_genes)
nrow(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org)


# plot
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/volcano_DE_cocul_vs_ctrl.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 20) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.1), log(1.1), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  ylim(0,330) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))
dev.off()


# Now plot marking genes of interest only
# Choose genes looking at the top different ones
filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org, outcome == "Up-regulated" & logFC > log(1.1))
filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org, outcome == "Down-regulated" & logFC < -log(1.1))

# Make a vector of chosen genes
de_markers_cocul <- c("ENO1", "ID3", "WLS", "COL3A1", "CANX", "KDELR2", "MEST", "PGK1", "CLU", "HSPA5", "ZIC2", "PKM", "TTR", "HNRNPM", "ID3", "BNIP3", "VIM", "SELENOM", "RHOC", # upregulated
                    "SPP1", "CRABP1", "STMN2", "SOX4", "DCX", "RBX1", "HES6", "GNG4", "TAGLN3", "NCAM1", "INA", "HMGB1", "SYNC", "RPS9", "CALM1", "DDX5", "PLCG2", "HES6", "RBX1", "MEIS2", "JPT1" # downregulated
                                                                       )

# Filter them from the data frame
de_markers <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org %>% filter(feature %in% de_markers_cocul)

# Plot
plot <- ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  #geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 70) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.1), log(1.1), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  ylim(0,330) +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))

# Add labels
plot <- plot +
  geom_label_repel(data = de_markers, mapping = aes(logFC, -log10(padj), label = feature), size = 3, max.overlaps = 70) #+
  #geom_point(data = DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_mg %>% filter(feature %in% de_markers_cocul), color = "yellow") 

# plot
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/volcano_DE_cocul_vs_ctrl_labeled.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
plot
dev.off()

```

```{r perform wilcoxon test on organoid retina}
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina<- wilcoxauc(seurat_org_retina, group_by = "condition") %>%
  filter(group == "COCUL") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA))

# Many padj values equal 0, meaning that they go to infinity as -lo10(padj) and cannot be plotted.
# The reason is that wilcoaux function rounds extremely small values to 0.
# To circumvent this is issue, we can change the 0 p-values (or p-adjusted values) to take the minimum value detected.
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina$padj[DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina$padj[which(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina$padj != 0)])

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           logFC < -log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina) 


blacklist <- c(grep("^MT-", DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina$feature, value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
diff_genes <- setdiff(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina$feature,blacklist)
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina %>% filter(feature %in% diff_genes)
nrow(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina)

# plot
plot <- ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj),label=DEG)) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.1), log(1.1), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))

plot

# Now plot marking genes of interest only
# Choose genes looking at the top different ones
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina.up <- filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina, outcome == "Up-regulated" & logFC > log(1.1))
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina.down <- filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina, outcome == "Down-regulated" & logFC < -log(1.1))

# Make a vector of chosen genes
de_markers_cocul <- c("SPP1", "FTL", "S100A11", "FTH", "PPBP", "APOC1", "CXCL5", "APOE", "CTSD", "LYZ", "CCL2" # downregulated
                                                                       )

# Filter them from the data frame
de_markers <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina %>% filter(feature %in% de_markers_cocul)

# Plot
plot <- ggplot(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina, aes(x = logFC, y = -log10(padj))) +
  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  #geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 70) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.1), log(1.1), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))

# Add labels
plot <- plot +
  geom_label_repel(data = de_markers, mapping = aes(logFC, -log10(padj), label = feature), size = 3, max.overlaps = 50) 
plot 

# plot
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/volcano_DE_cocul_vs_ctrl_retina.pdf", height = 5, width = 8)
plot
dev.off()

write.csv(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina.up, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina_UP.csv")
write.csv(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina.down, "Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina_DOWN.csv")
```

#### Perform wilcoxon test on organoid immature choroid plexus 2
```{r perform wilcoxon test on organoid immature choroid plexus 2}

# Subset immature choroid plexus 2 only
seurat_org_im_choroid_2 <- subset(seurat, subset = celltype %in% c("Immature choroid plexus 2")) %>%
        FindVariableFeatures(nfeatures = 3000)

# Run wilcoxon test
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2 <- wilcoxauc(seurat_org_im_choroid_2, group_by = "condition") %>%
  filter(group == "COCUL") %>%
  mutate(DE = abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01) %>%
  mutate(DEG = ifelse(abs(logFC)>log(1.1) & padj < 0.01, feature, NA))

# Many padj values equal 0, meaning that they go to infinity as -lo10(padj) and cannot be plotted.
# The reason is that wilcoaux function rounds extremely small values to 0.
# To circumvent this is issue, we can change the 0 p-values (or p-adjusted values) to take the minimum value detected.
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2$padj[DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2$padj == 0.000000e+00] <- min(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2$padj[which(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2$padj != 0)])

# Add to the table another column wtih outcome
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2 <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2 %>% 
  mutate(
    outcome = case_when(logFC > log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Up-regulated",
                           logFC < -log(1.1) & padj < 0.01 ~ "Down-regulated",
                           TRUE ~ "Unchanged")
    )
head(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2) 


blacklist <- c(grep("^MT-", DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2$feature, value=T), read.table("/home/marinani/Scripts/Databases/Gene_lists/RPgenes_bak.txt")[,1])
diff_genes <- setdiff(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2$feature,blacklist)
DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2 <- DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2 %>% filter(feature %in% diff_genes)
nrow(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2)

# plot

  geom_point(shape=21, size=2, aes(fill=outcome), position = "jitter") +
  geom_text_repel(max.overlaps = 30) +
  geom_vline(xintercept=c(-log(1.1), log(1.1), 0),  linetype="dotted") +
  geom_hline(yintercept=-log10(0.01), linetype="dotted") +
  theme_classic() + 
  scale_fill_manual(values = c("#58B6AC", "gray50", "#C73E04")) +
  xlab(expression("log"[2]*"FC")) + 
  ylab(expression("-log"[10]*"p_adj"))

plot

DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2.down <- filter(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2, outcome == "Down-regulated" & logFC < -log(1.1))
```

```{r create a table with no. DEGs all cell types}

# list of all tables:
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_1
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_ch_stroma
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_choroid
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain_npc
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_1
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_2
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_prolif_npc
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hindbrain
# DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain

list_DE_tables <- list(DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_prolif_npc, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_1, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_2,DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hindbrain, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain_npc, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_1, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_choroid, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_ch_stroma, DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina)

no.DEGs <- matrix(c("DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_prolif_npc", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_1", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_2","DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hindbrain", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain_npc", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_1", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_choroid",  "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_ch_stroma", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina"), ncol=1, byrow=TRUE)
no.DEGs <- as.data.frame(no.DEGs)
colnames(no.DEGs) <- c("celltype")

no.up <- c()
no.down <- c()
for (i in list_DE_tables) {
  no.up <- rbind(no.up, sum(i$outcome == "Up-regulated"))
  no.down <- rbind(no.down, sum(i$outcome ==  "Down-regulated"))
}

no.DEGs$no.up <- no.up
no.DEGs$no.down <- no.down

no.DEGs$celltype <- factor(no.DEGs$celltype,levels = c("DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_prolif_npc", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_1", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hind_npc_2","DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_hindbrain", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_forebrain_npc", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_1", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_im_choroid_2", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_choroid",  "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_ch_stroma", "DE_wilcoxauc_in_vitro_org_retina"))

cols <- c( "#9A5C6B","#6B6D84","#54768D","#3F8C70","#65935B","#ACA64D","#E7AF40","#E0922C","#DB7A2F","#DA6138","#DD4345")
  
pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/lollipop_DEGs_up.pdf", height = 7, width = 5)
ggplot(no.DEGs, aes(x = celltype, y = no.up)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = celltype, xend = celltype, y = 0, yend = no.up), col = col_ct) +
  geom_point(aes(x=celltype, y=no.up), size = 8, col = cols) +
  geom_text(aes(x=celltype,  y=no.up, label = no.up), color = "black", size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Cell type") + 
  ylab("Number of up-regualted DEGs") +
  ylim(0, 900) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text( angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
dev.off()

pdf("Plots/Co-culture_timecourse/Organoid_data/lollipop_DEGs_down.pdf", height = 7, width = 5)
ggplot(no.DEGs, aes(x = celltype, y = no.down)) +
  geom_segment(aes(x = celltype, xend = celltype, y = 0, yend = no.down), col = col_ct) +
  geom_point(aes(x=celltype, y=no.down), size = 8, col = cols) +
  geom_text(aes(x=celltype,  y=no.down, label = no.down), color = "black", size = 3) +
  theme_classic() +
  xlab("Cell type") + 
  ylab("Number of down-regualted DEGs") +
  ylim(0, 900) +
  theme(axis.text.x = element_text( angle = 45, hjust = 1)) 
dev.off()

```
